## File: facebookresearch_flsim/flsim/reducers/tests/test_round_reducer.py

Prompts

```
['test the RoundReducer class with SUM, AVERAGE, WEIGHTED_SUM, and WEIGHTED_AVERAGE reduction types', 'test the DPRoundReducer clipping behavior when model update norms exceed the clipping threshold', 'test the DPRoundReducer noise addition by mocking the privacy engine noise generator', 'test the WeightedDPRoundReducer with BIASED and UNBIASED estimator types for weighted average reduction', 'test multi-process distributed reduction using torch.distributed and multiprocessing with the RoundReducer']
```

```
{'test_round_reducer_reduction_types': 'test the RoundReducer class with SUM, AVERAGE, WEIGHTED_SUM, and WEIGHTED_AVERAGE reduction types', 'test_dp_round_reducer_clipping': 'test the DPRoundReducer clipping behavior when model update norms exceed the clipping threshold', 'test_dp_round_reducer_noise': 'test the DPRoundReducer noise addition by mocking the privacy engine noise generator', 'test_weighted_dp_round_reducer_estimators': 'test the WeightedDPRoundReducer with BIASED and UNBIASED estimator types for weighted average reduction', 'test_multiprocess_reduction': 'test multi-process distributed reduction using torch.distributed and multiprocessing with the RoundReducer'}
```
